method: Exact-colour visible columns in the embedded rasters; affine axes calibrated from printed ticks; legend excluded; no interpolation across occluded columns. Numerical fields are not input to this extraction.
scope: Printed pressure at y=1/2, not a volume norm. A hidden colour or overlapping line cannot be reconstructed from the image.

coordinate_uncertainty.interpretation: One raster pixel, in addition to the retained visible line-thickness span; does not bound a hidden overlapping curve.
